notes: Loan-register sheet: names at left and papers or notes at right. The entries range from Husemöller/Schlessinger through Harder/Artin; many are cancelled. Cancellation is recorded without asserting that a loan was returned.

The Raynaud entry carries the authorial (?) after Popps. The Picard ordinal and the index following pi do not occur in an argument that could settle their form; no theorem was used to replace their ink.
No title sheet, date, page count, or mathematical proof occurs here. The lower-left 4 is archive numbering, retained only as a TeX comment.
